{{short description|Vietnamese-American mathematician}}
[[File:Pham Tiep Oberwolfach 2020.jpg|thumb|Pham Tiep at [[Mathematisches Forschungsinstitut Oberwolfach|Oberwolfach]] in 2020]]

'''Pham Huu Tiep''' ({{langx|vi|Phạm Hữu Tiệp}}) is a [[Vietnamese Americans|Vietnamese-American]] [[mathematician]] specializing in [[group theory]] and [[representation theory]].  He is currently a Joshua Barlaz Distinguished Professor of Mathematics at [[Rutgers University]].

Pham Tiep graduated from [[Chu Văn An High School (Hanoi)|Chu Văn An High School]], and received a silver medal at the [[International Mathematical Olympiad|IMO]] in [[London]] in 1979.<ref>[https://www.imo-official.org/participant_r.aspx?id=16581 Phạm Hưũ Tiệp] Official IMO page</ref> He received his Ph.D. at [[Moscow University]] in 1988 under supervision of [[Alexei Kostrikin]].<ref>[http://www.genealogy.ams.org/id.php?id=14822&fChrono=1 Mathematics Genealogy Project]</ref> He gave an invited talk at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in [[Rio de Janeiro]] in [[List of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers#2018, Rio de Janeiro | 2018]]. He is a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]], 
a [[Clay Institute]] Senior Scholar, and a [[Simons Foundation|Simons]] Fellow.

Pham was the fifth Vietnamese mathematician invited to speak at the [[List of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|International Congress of Mathematicians]], following [[Frédéric Pham]] [[List of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers#1970, Nice | (1970)]], [[Duong Hong Phong]] [[List of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers#1994, Zürich | (1994)]], [[Ngô Bảo Châu]] [[List of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers#2006, Madrid | (2006,2010)]] and [[Van H. Vu]][[List of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers#2014, Seoul | (2014)]].

Pham was a member of the 2010 collaboration which completed the proof of [[Perfect group#Ore's conjecture|Ore's conjecture]].

In a September 2024 paper, Pham, along with Gunter Malle, Gabriel Navarro and Amanda Schaeffer Fry, proved<ref name="HeightZero">{{cite journal | last1=Malle | first1=Gunter | last2=Navarro | first2=Gabriel | last3=Schaeffer Fry | first3=Amanda | last4=Pham | first4=Tiep | title=Brauer's Height Zero Conjecture | journal=Annals of Mathematics | volume=200 | issue=2 | date=1 September 2024 | issn=0003-486X | doi=10.4007/annals.2024.200.2.4 | pages=557–608| arxiv=2209.04736 }}</ref> [[Brauer's height zero conjecture]] on the modular representation theory of [[Modular representation theory|Brauer blocks]] and their [[Modular representation theory#Defect groups|defect groups]].

Also in 2024,<ref name="CharacterBounds">{{cite journal | last1=Larsen | first1=Michael | last2=Pham | first2=Tiep | title=Uniform character bounds for finite classical groups | journal=Annals of Mathematics | volume=200 | issue=1 | date=1 July 2024 | issn=0003-486X | doi=10.4007/annals.2024.200.1.1 | pages=1–70| arxiv=2403.09046 }}</ref> Pham, along with Michael Larsen and others, derived uniform character bounds for various finite classical groups, leading to substantial progress on Thompson's conjecture<ref name="ThompsonConjecture">{{cite journal | last1=Ellers | first1=Erich | last2=Gordeev | first2=Nikolai | title=On the conjectures of J. Thompson and O. Ore | journal=Transactions of the American Mathematical Society | volume=350 | issue=9 | date=1998 | issn=0002-9947 | doi=10.1090/S0002-9947-98-01953-9 | doi-access=free | pages=3657–3671}}</ref> that each finite non-abelian simple group <math> G = C^2</math> for some [[conjugacy class]] <math>C \subseteq G</math>.

==Selected papers==
* 2018: "Character bounds for finite groups of Lie type", [[Acta Math.]] 221 (2018), 1 – 57 (with [[Roman Bezrukavnikov]], [[Martin Liebeck]], and [[Aner Shalev]])
* 2016: {{cite journal | title=The <math>\alpha</math>-invariant and Thompson's conjecture | journal=[[Forum Math. Pi|Forum of Mathematics, Pi]] | date=2016 | volume=4 | issn=2050-5086 | doi=10.1017/fmp.2016.3 | doi-access=free | last1=Huu Tiep | first1=Pham }} e5, 28 pages
* 2013: "Characters of relative p'-degree over normal subgroups", [[Ann. of Math.]] 178 (2013), 1135 – 1171 (with [[Gabriel Navarro Ortega|Gabriel Navarro]])
* 2011: "Waring problem for finite simple groups", [[Ann. of Math.]] 174 (2011), 1885 – 1950 (with [[Michael J. Larsen|Michael Larsen]] and [[Aner Shalev]])
* 2011: "A reduction theorem for the Alperin weight conjecture", [[Invent. Math.]] 184 (2011), 529 – 565 (with [[Gabriel Navarro Ortega|Gabriel Navarro]])
* 2010: "The Ore conjecture", [[Journal of the European Mathematical Society]] (with [[Martin Liebeck]], EA O'Brien, [[Aner Shalev]])
* 2008: "Symmetric powers and a problem of Kollar and Larsen", [[Invent. Math.]] 174 (2008), 505 – 554 (with [[Robert M. Guralnick]])
